title: Dexter (YC F24) Is Hiring a Founding Engineer in Berlin
summary: Dexter, a Y Combinator F24 batch startup based in Berlin, is actively recruiting a Founding Engineer to join their early-stage team. This is an early hiring opportunity at a newly funded startup that likely operates in the AI/tech space given the YC backing.
problem_solved: Providing early talent opportunity to build foundational technical systems at a new YC-backed startup from the ground up.
why_valuable: Offers unique chance to become a founding technical member with equity upside at a Y Combinator-backed company in the growing Berlin tech ecosystem.
